items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: It might be the same fella, Mike Donald.

ctx.x: No, this guy was a bass player and also used to play, he played a tuba too. Yeah.
It might be the same fella, Mike Donald. I just thought I'd check. Bill, maybe we could get him to just tell everybody hello.

Yeah, the trouble is the tape is down near the end there now, and that's when the machine starts slowing down. Alright, well we'll wait, we'll wait till we get a new tape. We'll get on a new reel in just a minute. You've got a couple more questions there, though. Oh, I was going to ask something about your clarinet style, which is that original, you know, that good tone you got there that's really got some real guts to it. What? How do you do that? Or what, where did you first get onto that? I mean, you know, I…
